basis: Completed matched Intel context comparison, including both frozen evaluation panels and all64 child generations.
reason: Training context512 reduced context512 development loss from1.64902 to1.02626 versus context256 training; context256 scores remained close(1.08887 versus1.09044). Use the larger usable context for the LR test, without claiming coherence is solved.
generation_findings: Neither arm reliably completed any of the four long-prompt facts in either mode. The512 arm improved some short name/sharing continuations but retained repetitions, object confusion and unresolved problems.
limits: One seed, reused development panels, different training block order, assistant inspection; no statistical or general quality claim.
